reconcileReason.duplicateLiveAbout: This wallpaper exists in both Live {location1} and {location2} folders. Please remove one if they are identical, or ignore this detection.

reconcileReason.duplicateLiveIgnoredAbout: This wallpaper exists in both Live {location1} and {location2} folders. This detection is ignored until the live copies change or you show it again.
reconcileReason.conflictingBackupsIgnoredAbout: These conflicting backup copies are ignored. Neither copy will be deleted or replaced automatically; the detection returns if the backup evidence changes or you show it again.
reconcileReason.duplicateLiveGroupAbout: The same wallpaper was detected in more than one live folder. Open Details to review the detected locations.

backup.emptyJunkAbout: These folders are empty or contain only disposable shader data. They are checked again before moving to the Recycle Bin.

about.synced: These wallpapers have a current backup in the matching backup library and no unresolved conflict.
about.notBackedUp: These live wallpapers have no usable backup copy in either backup library.
about.vanished: These wallpapers exist only in backup. No live copy is found in the libraries.
about.updateAvailable: These wallpapers need their backup refreshed or moved into the matching backup library.
about.updateDismissed: These content updates are ignored. A later live version automatically returns them to Update / Sync.

action.backUpOne: Copy this live wallpaper to its matching backup folder? Existing backup files are updated; nothing is deleted.
action.backUpMany: Back up these {count} live wallpapers? Existing backup files are updated; nothing is deleted.
action.updateOne: Mirror this live wallpaper into its matching backup? Files no longer present in live will be removed from the backup. A misplaced backup is recycled only after the matching backup is created successfully.
action.updateMany: Mirror these {count} live wallpapers into their matching backups? Files no longer present in live will be removed from the backups. Misplaced backups are recycled only after the matching backups are created successfully.
action.selectiveUpdateOne: Apply the selected changes to this backup? Files marked 'This will be removed' are deleted; files you marked to keep stay unchanged.
action.restoreOne: Restore this vanished wallpaper to MyProjects? The backup copy stays unchanged.
action.restoreMany: Restore these {count} vanished wallpapers to MyProjects? The backup copies stay unchanged.
action.recycleOne: Move this wallpaper's empty or junk folders to the Recycle Bin? Live shader-cache folders, empty folders, and backup cache are checked again first.
action.recycleMany: Move empty or junk folders for these {count} wallpapers to the Recycle Bin? Each target will be checked again first.
action.showAgainOne: Show this ignored update again under Update / Sync? No wallpaper files will change.
action.showAgainMany: Show these {count} ignored detections again? No wallpaper files will change.
action.folderUnavailable: A required folder is not configured.
action.sourceMissing: The source folder is no longer available. Rescan first.
action.stateChanged: This folder changed after the scan. No action was taken. Rescan first.
action.packageSelectionBlocked: scene.pkg has per-file choices that cannot be applied until WeRePKG can repack packages. Keep the whole current scene.pkg or replace the whole package instead.
action.trashUnconfirmed: Windows did not confirm the Recycle Bin move.
action.targetExists: A live folder with this name already exists.
action.unsafeDestination: The destination is inside the source folder. Choose separate library and backup folders.
action.sourceChanged: The live folder changed during the backup. Run the backup again.
action.linkFound: This folder contains a link and was not copied.
action.ignoreUpdateOne: Move this content update to Ignored? No wallpaper files will change. It returns automatically when the live version changes.
action.ignoreUpdateMany: Move these {count} content updates to Ignored? No wallpaper files will change. Each returns automatically when its live version changes.
action.ignoreReconcileOne: Move the ignorable Reconcile detection(s) for this wallpaper to Ignored? No wallpaper files will change. A detection returns automatically if its evidence changes.
action.showReconcileAgainOne: Return this wallpaper's ignored Reconcile detection(s) to Needs reconciling? No wallpaper files will change.

junk.emptyAbout: These folders contain no files at all. They are checked again before moving to the Recycle Bin so a folder that changed after the scan is left alone.
junk.shaderAbout: These folders contain only rebuildable Wallpaper Engine shader cache, such as .dxs or rebuilt shader data. No wallpaper payload is present. They are checked again before moving to the Recycle Bin.
junk.mixedAbout: These tiles represent more than one disposable folder for the same wallpaper, with a mix of truly empty and shader-cache-only folders. Every target is checked again before moving to the Recycle Bin.
junk.detailsEmpty: This tile is truly empty: its disposable folder contains no files.
junk.detailsShader: This tile is shader cache only: it contains rebuildable shader data and no wallpaper payload.
junk.detailsMixed: This tile represents multiple disposable folders, including both truly empty and shader-cache-only folders.

backup.ignoredAbout: Detections you chose to ignore. Files remain unchanged; detections return when their evidence changes or when you show them again.

ignoredGroup.updateAbout: Ignored content updates. Required Sync work still stays active.
ignoredGroup.reconcileAbout: Ignored Reconcile detections. No wallpaper files were changed.

integrity.title: Integrity check
integrity.about: Scans every wallpaper folder in your libraries and backups. Checks whether Wallpaper Engine can load them. Detected issues appear below.
integrity.clean: No problems found in the scanned folders.

advice.packedSceneNoProject: These folders contain packed wallpapers but no project.json. Wallpaper Engine cannot see them. Resolve extracts them as projects.
advice.unpackedSceneNoProject: These folders contain scene.json but no project.json. Wallpaper Engine cannot see them. Resolve creates the missing project.json.
advice.mediaOnly: These folders contain images or videos but no wallpaper project. Resolve can create one or move the folder to the Recycle Bin.
advice.payloadMissing: Each project is missing the file shown below. Resolve restores it from the same wallpaper in the paired library or backup.
advice.projectUnreadable: Wallpaper Engine cannot read project.json in these folders. Resolve replaces it from the same wallpaper in the paired library or backup.
advice.shaderCacheOnly: These folders contain only shader cache left after Workshop wallpapers were removed. They are safe to delete.

integrity.resolvedAdvice: Resolved during this app session. This list clears when the app closes.
